name: Corporate Action Rate 127
definition: Specifies rates related to a corporate action option.

ProposedRate.name: Proposed Rate
ProposedRate.definition: Rate proposed in a remarketing of variable rate notes.

RequestedWithholdingTaxRate.name: Requested Withholding Tax Rate
RequestedWithholdingTaxRate.definition: Requested tax rate that will be withheld by the tax authorities of the jurisdiction of the issuer, for which a relief at source and/or reclaim may be possible.

RequestedSecondLevelTaxRate.name: Requested Second Level Tax Rate
RequestedSecondLevelTaxRate.definition: Requested rate at which the income will be withheld by the jurisdiction other than the jurisdiction of the issuer’s country of tax incorporation, for which a relief at source and/or reclaim may be possible.
